answer_1.quote: Syntactically-controlled paraphrase generation, which aims to generate paraphrases that conform with given syntactic structures, has drawn increasing attention in the community.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of paraphrases with: 1) alignment-based metrics to examine the semantics preservation: including BLEU, ROUGE scores and METEOR... 2) syntactic conformation metrics: Tree-Edit Distances (TED) scores...

answer_4.quote: We validate the chosen paraphrases for the first 100 instances in the test sets on Amazon Mturk, and report as Valid@100...
answer_4.guideline: We instruct them to only label a paraphrase as valid when the paraphrase is natural, fluent, and preserves the semantics of the source sentence.
